neighbours.label: the token ' quite', in all its uses (quite long, quite a few, not quite); synonyms like very, rather and pretty stay quiet
fire: The lecture turned out to be quite long for such a simple topic.
Our flight was delayed for quite a while at the gate.
My brother is quite good at fixing old radios.
There were quite a few birds on the lake this morning.
The soup tasted quite salty after the second boil.
Nobody has argued the point quite so well as her teacher.
I am not quite sure what the letter means.
That was quite the surprise for the whole family.
quiet: The lecture turned out to be very long for such a simple topic.
Our flight was delayed for a while at the gate.
My brother is pretty good at fixing old radios.
There were a few birds on the lake this morning.
The soup tasted rather salty after the second boil.
Nobody has argued the point so well as her teacher.
I am not really sure what the letter means.
That was a quiet surprise for the whole family.

notes: Card: ' quite' x32 of the top 32. Probes: ' quite' 0.651-0.711 on three sentences; 'very different' 0.015, 'rather a lot' 0.009. This early-layer pole is small (max 0.24) and 87% in the gate-closed regime.
